model_cards.use: flagship repo id, current version name, licence tag, parameter counts and repository date
model_cards.terms: Public Hugging Face model cards, read as published on checked_at. A licence tag that is not an OSI licence id names a custom licence whose text is not reviewed here.

basis.rows: Every row is a model family in the D91 sense: the slug carries no version, and one current flagship Hugging Face repo stands for the family.
basis.relation: This file refreshes family rows of the open-weight seed in PR #298 (docs/refresh/open-weight-models.json, not merged) to the generations the vendors ship now. It does not fork that seed: a row here carries only the refreshed facts, and #298 rows not listed here are unchanged. When #298 merges, its rows can be folded into this format.
basis.facts: Every stated fact sits under facts with its own source_url. A fact the reviewed sources do not state is left out, never estimated.
basis.licence_review: not_required only when the licence tag is an OSI licence id; pending when the tag names a custom licence or no licence is stated. The review happens before activation, not in this seed.
basis.status: Rows are inactive. A loader never activates a row and never changes an existing row's status or metrics.
basis.scope: This file is a reviewed seed only. Nothing here is read by ranking or scoring code, and it carries no metrics.
